name: Convex-Treelike and Realizable Ample Classes Are Incomparable
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Neither convex-treelike partial cubes nor realizable ample classes contain the other.
proof: $E_{26}$ has a peripheral recursion but its four separator ratios force a strict cyclic inequality. The pentagonal class is realized by the tangent lines of a regular pentagon, but every coordinate is nonperipheral.
